meta.rule: A fact renders in the UI only if allowed_on_site is true AND source_url or source_note is non-empty. tests/unit/facts.test.js enforces this. Never edit allowed_on_site to true without adding a source.

confidence_levels.corroborated: Independently echoed by a reachable third-party source during Phase 0.
confidence_levels.seed: From the campaign's own master-prompt fact pack. Plausible and campaign-attested, but the primary document could not be opened in this environment.
confidence_levels.campaign-attested: The campaign asserts it in its own published words (quotes, statements).

facts.claim: Suresh Vuyyuru is a dad, a husband, a farmer, and a software engineer.
facts.source_note: His own 2024 candidate statement. Corroborated by search summary.

facts.claim: His family made Mountain House their home in 2020, during the pandemic.
facts.source_note: His words: "In 2020, during the challenging times of the pandemic, my family and I made Mountain House our home."

facts.claim: He moved to Mountain House after about 25 years in the Bay Area.
facts.source_note: 2024 Mountain House Matters candidate statement.

facts.claim: He also appears in public records as Suresh Babu Vuyyuru.
facts.source_note: Public records. Used only for the legal-name line in the finance disclosure, never in prose.

facts.claim: He founded the Mountain House Sports & Recreation Club in 2020 and serves as its chairman.
facts.source_note: MHSRC describes him as the visionary behind the club. Corroborated by search summary.

facts.claim: MHSRC runs volleyball, throwball, badminton and ping pong tournaments, cultural performances, festivals, a local business expo, youth services, and fitness and art workshops.
facts.source_note: MHSRC program list. Tournament sports corroborated by search summary and by his own 2024 statement.

facts.claim: MHSRC's registered nonprofit entity name and tax status.
facts.source_note: BLOCKED. Search suggests a related entity 'Mountain House Sports Club Inc' (Tracy, CA). Do not assert legal name or 501(c) status until the campaign confirms. See PHASE0.md F-3.

facts.claim: He is a member of the Rotary Club of Mountain House.
facts.source_note: Campaign fact pack; Tracy Press coverage of the club's blood drive. Confirm with the club before launch.

facts.claim: He donated blood at the Rotary Club of Mountain House's first Vitalant blood drive on July 25, 2026, in the Mountain House Library parking lot.
facts.source_note: Tracy Press, July 31, 2026. Photographed as a donor. Article URL to be added by the campaign.

facts.claim: Rotary recognition described as a 'Quiet, Powerful and Strong' member.
facts.source_note: From his own January 23, 2024 public post. HOLD: verify the exact award name with the club before publishing it. An award named wrong is worse than an award unmentioned.

facts.claim: He applied and was recommended as an applicant for the Mountain House Parks and Recreation Commission.
facts.source_note: CSD-era public agenda. He APPLIED and was RECOMMENDED. He did NOT serve. Any copy that implies service is a defect — see tests/unit/facts.test.js overclaim guard.

facts.claim: He ran for Mountain House City Council At-Large in the March 5, 2024 incorporation election and did not win.
facts.source_note: Ballotpedia 2024 candidate page. Corroborated by search summary. We state the loss plainly — see PREMORTEM P-12.

facts.claim: 2024 vote totals.
facts.source_note: NOT COLLECTED. San Joaquin County Registrar certified results needed. Do not estimate, do not round, do not say 'came close' with a number attached.

facts.claim: He is a qualified candidate for Mountain House City Council in the November 3, 2026 election. He pulled nomination papers on July 31, 2026 and filed on August 7, 2026.
facts.source_note: City of Mountain House candidate log. Page was egress-blocked during Phase 0; dates are seed-sourced and carry a verify banner on /voter-info.

facts.claim: Two City Council seats are on the ballot, each for a four-year term. Voters may vote for up to two candidates.
facts.source_note: City clerk candidate log, seed-sourced.

facts.claim: The election is Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
facts.source_note: City of Mountain House elections page.

facts.claim: Mountain House became a city on July 1, 2024. It is California's newest city.
facts.source_note: Incorporation date from the campaign config; the March 5, 2024 election that chose the first mayor and council is corroborated by search summary.

facts.claim: Issues he has publicly named: economic development for a new city, public safety, education, improved recreation facilities, platforms for residents to showcase talent, traffic, water and utility bills, sports and recreation, emergency preparedness and neighborhood watch, and showing up at board meetings to carry resident concerns.
facts.source_note: His 2024 Macaroni KID statement and Mountain House Matters. This is the complete published list. Do not add an eleventh issue.

facts.source_note: 2024 public listing. Campaign must confirm it is still monitored before launch.
